title: FIFA World Cup 2026: Knockout Stage Qualifications and Match Updates
summary: The FIFA World Cup 2026 is underway, with several teams securing or vying for knockout stage berths. Mexico has advanced to the knockout stage and secured the top spot in Group A after victories over South Africa and South Korea. Bosnia and Herzegovina have ended Qatar's World Cup hopes and are close to sealing their own knockout berth, while Canada made history despite a loss to Switzerland. South Korea needs a win or draw against South Africa to advance, with South Africa requiring a win to avoid elimination.

Bosnia and Herzegovina eliminated Qatar from World Cup contention.
